name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Ever since 1988 Heavenly Heat Saunas have provided its customers with best quality, safe and most effective way to improve health and detoxify from all the toxins people consume every day. Unique methods of construction of each sauna unit, top grade materials and wide range of health benefits anyone can gain by purchasing and Infrared Sauna from Heavenly Saunas makes this company one of the best choices.



These Infrared Saunas are built in a way to maximize the effectiveness of each sauna session, making the process of detoxification comfortable and harmless, eliminating even heavy metals from the body.



Apart with one- two and three-person sauna units Heavenly Saunas can also build a customized sauna up to 6 people capacity. The design is well thought-through applying the vast knowledge of infrared light therapy and includes additional features like tempered glass windows, passive air circulation, filtered air vent, Carbon heaters with low EMF and etc. An option of full-spectrum infrared is also available to widen the sauna session experience.
